changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led document-to-payables proposal with exact invoice identity, duplicate checks, approval state, and no implicit payment.

title: Invoice Intake to Reviewed Payable
description: Extract an authorized vendor invoice, reconcile it against current payables, and prepare an owner-reviewed decision without posting or paying it.
setup_prompt: Use Invoice Intake to Reviewed Payable as a chat-led proposal. Inspect compatible existing Document Intake Assistant and Spend & Payables Coordinator Crews, source documents, current payable and vendor records, schema, duplicate rule, approval policy, and payment authority. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, exact artifacts and validator steps, one manual invoice, and an owner review. Show the concrete plan before Builder applies it. Selection does not upload documents, create vendors or bills, approve expenses, pay an invoice, or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Authorized invoice document, immutable document ID/hash and version
Legal entity, vendor identity, currency, period and time zone
Required invoice fields, tax/total validation and duplicate rules
Current vendor, bill, credit and payment source or export
Payables review owner, approval policy and payment authority boundary
Manual-only or reviewed document-arrival event and cadence

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create reviewed missing roles with stable idempotency keys

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass only the validated invoice extraction to the payables Crew

recommended_tools.name: Authorized document store or bounded files
recommended_tools.purpose: Read exact invoice version and page-level evidence

recommended_tools.name: Accounting or AP provider or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read current vendor, bill, credit, approval and payment state

recommended_tools.name: Approved AP record destination
recommended_tools.purpose: Apply a separately approved exact bill write and return a provider receipt

pulse_focus.label: Invoice intake and payable review
focus_areas: Whether every proposed payable has verified source fields and a current duplicate check
Whether pending approval, scheduled payment and paid state remain distinct
review_when: A document version changes, a possible duplicate appears, an invoice approaches due date, or approval or payment state changes

outputs: Reviewed document and payable source map with two Crew bindings
Validated document-intake-record/v1 with field spans and duplicate key
Validated payable-review/v1 with current ledger, policy and owner decision state
One manual invoice review, action ledger and activation choice
